integrity: The modal step was checked against the primary 2026 paper at its finite first-order reduction and its polynomial-time theorem. The circuit step was reconstructed by direct quantifier expansion for a fixed first-order sentence and compared with a standard descriptive-complexity source. The originality search compared the exact statement against targeted literature searches and nearby published findings; no equivalent modal AC^0 strengthening was located.
scientific_limitations: The circuit upper bound is for the canonical labeled adjacency-matrix encoding of finite unimodal frames. It is an obstruction theorem and does not supply lower bounds for any particular logic. The parity corollary requires a separate AC^0 many-one reduction.
title: Constant-depth finite-frame validity barrier for elementary modal logics
